name: turing-vetting
description: Verify material factual claims and distinguish source-backed evidence from author testimony.
---

# Evidence vetting

Follow [the editorial contract](../../../docs/editorial-contract.md). Identify which material claims require external verification. A personal recollection or opinion should be attributed and bounded, not assigned a fabricated web citation.

For each researched claim, verify the source exists, supports the exact statement, and is current enough. Prefer primary sources; triangulate high-impact or disputed claims where feasible. Label strong, moderate or weak support and explain limitations. Separate inference from fact and preserve contradictions with the intended argument.

If support cannot be found, state the gap and suggest qualification, removal or a focused author question. Do not invent citations, statistics or source contents. Stop when the scoped evidence question is answered or the budget/access limit is reached.
